name: claude-skills
description: A collection of custom skills for Claude Code — teammates (subagent teams with no orchestrator), codebase-guardian (disciplined, toolchain-validated editing of existing codebases), memory (durable hierarchical context across sessions), agents-dox (the DOX AGENTS.md contract hierarchy), lsp (semantic code navigation via language servers), schema-aware-db (introspect-first database work for SQL and NoSQL), ponytail (end-of-session loose-end wrap-up with a handoff tail), and decision-maker (fast, calibrated typed decisions via TypeSafe Jev with any System One provider). Each works standalone and composes with the others.
